They wear matching white football jerseys with gold and black trim, paired with light-blue oversized cargo denim, white trousers, jewelry, watches, and a vintage brown leather shoulder bag.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 group portrait in stadium stands, four subjects arranged with one woman foreground left leaning forward and making a peace sign while laughing, one foreground right seated with crossed legs and hands on knees, and two women behind smiling. Empty dark-blue seats, glass safety barrier, concrete steps, and stadium architecture fill the background.

prompt.technical_specs: Realistic smartphone social photography, vertical 9:16, group portrait framing, f/2.8-style moderate background separation, natural skin and fabric texture, vibrant but restrained color, no artificial HDR look.
